verdict.rationale: The firm's own Data Protection and Privacy page says it advises on cybersecurity and privacy compliance and covers breach response, alongside DPDP Act 2023 and GDPR/CCPA alignment. However, breach response appears only as a single line-item mention, and nothing describes regulator-facing incident work. Missing for 10: explicit regulator-facing work (e.g., notifications to the Data Protection Board or CERT-In, or regulator engagement), detail on incident-response scope or process, any dedicated incident-response page or publication, and independent corroboration.
